Overnight focaccia

Makes one half-sheet pan.

500 g bread flour
400 g lukewarm water
10 g fine salt
4 g instant yeast
60 g olive oil, plus more for the pan
flaky salt and rosemary for the top

The night before, mix flour, water, salt and yeast until no dry flour is left. Cover and leave in the fridge 12 to 18 hours.

In the morning, oil the pan generously, tip the dough in, and leave it at room temperature for 3 hours until it fills the pan and jiggles.

Heat the oven to 230°C with a rack in the lower third. Oil your fingers, dimple the dough all over, drizzle with the remaining oil, and scatter flaky salt and rosemary.

Bake 22 minutes, until deep golden on top and crisp underneath. Let it rest 10 minutes in the pan before cutting.
